fusions.name: Scribed Reach
fusions.desc: Writes a link out to an enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 40% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sealing Clause
fusions.desc: Writes a binding sigil onto the first enemy it meets that deals 26 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Cadence
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Drilled
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
